full_resume:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Engineering leader with over a decade of experience steering software delivery and team development within cloud-centric and architecture-driven environments. Demonstrated expertise in managing multiple engineering teams, owning and executing complex roadmaps, and leading architecture reviews to ensure alignment with strategic business goals. Proven track record in mentoring engineering leads, stabilizing delivery operations during rapid scale-up phases, and standardizing engineering processes to boost productivity and release cadence. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, hiring facilitation, and cultivating high-performance, collaborative teams.

LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE

- Managed multiple engineering teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and accountability while mentoring engineering leads to develop leadership capabilities.
- Owned and drove engineering roadmaps, aligning cross-functional teams and architecture decisions with strategic business objectives to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.
- Directed hiring support initiatives, partnering with recruitment to strengthen team capabilities and succession planning.
- Stabilized and optimized delivery operations during critical scale-up phases, enhancing team productivity and maintaining consistent release cadence amid rapid growth.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Engineering Leadership Roles

- Directed multiple engineering teams through end-to-end software delivery cycles, coordinating roadmaps and architecture reviews to align technical strategy with business goals.
- Supported hiring processes and mentored engineering leads to strengthen team capabilities and ensure timely release planning.
- Led architecture review sessions to uphold high standards of software design, scalability, and maintainability.
- Collaborated with stakeholders to manage delivery timelines, resolve operational challenges, and communicate progress effectively.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Leadership & Management:
- Team Leadership
- Mentoring
- Stakeholder Management
- Delivery Management
- Roadmap Coordination
- Release Planning

Technical Skills:
- Java
- Python
- Cloud Technologies
- Architecture Review
- AWS

Tools & Platforms:
- Jira
- Confluence

PROJECTS

Platform Modernization and Process Standardization

- Led platform modernization efforts to update legacy systems, improving maintainability, scalability, and alignment with current technology standards.
- Standardized engineering processes across teams to enhance consistency, reduce defects, and accelerate delivery timelines.
- Improved platform reliability and streamlined engineering workflows to support scalable and efficient software delivery.
strengths: Directed multiple engineering teams through end-to-end software delivery cycles, coordinating roadmaps and architecture reviews to align technical strategy with business goals; supported hiring and mentored engineering leads to strengthen team capabilities and ensure timely release planning.
Stabilized and optimized delivery operations during critical scale-up phases, enhancing team productivity and ensuring consistent release cadence amid rapid growth.
Improved platform reliability and streamlined engineering workflows to support scalable software delivery.
